description: Score Core V2. Impact is driven by explicit rule priority and a bounded aggregation policy, never by raw occurrence count. Dimension weights are fixed by the approved product contract and any candidate model that changes them is rejected.

calibration.evidence: The numeric policy is checked against independently adjudicated public-corpus projects plus controlled Great, Needs Work, and Critical contract fixtures with a 20% repository-root holdout. Unqualified heuristics remain advisory. One confirmed P0 caps the overall score below Needs Work, and repeated occurrences of one bounded rule saturate at twice its first-occurrence penalty.
